question: top 5 kids who improved the most in situps from baseline to endline

WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Child Name", "Sit Ups" AS baseline_situps
  FROM "sportathon_baseline"
),
endline AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Child Name", "Sit Ups" AS endline_situps
  FROM "sportathon_endline"
),
improvement AS (
  SELECT 
    b."Child ID", 
    b."Child Name", 
    b."Child ID" || ' baseline' AS baseline_id, 
    e."Child ID" || ' endline' AS endline_id, 
    b."Sit Ups" AS baseline_situps, 
    e."Sit Ups" AS endline_situps, 
    e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS improvement
  FROM baseline b
  JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
)
SELECT 
  "Child ID", 
  "Child Name", 
  baseline_id, 
  endline_id, 
  baseline_situps, 
  endline_situps, 
  improvement
FROM (
  SELECT 
    "Child ID", 
    "Child Name", 
    baseline_id, 
    endline_id, 
    baseline_situps, 
    endline_situps, 
    improvement,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY improvement DESC) AS row_num
  FROM improvement
) AS subquery
WHERE row_num <= 5
